title: "Wildfires"
author: "Mayah"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(leaflet)
library(jsonlite)

raw <- fromJSON("data/wildfires.geojson")
print(length(raw$features))

fire <- raw$features[1, ]
names(fire)

first_coordinate <- fire$geometry$coordinates[[1]][1, 1, ]
first_coordinate

fires <- jsonlite::read_json("data/wildfires.geojson") |>
  pluck("features") |>
  tibble(features = _) |>
  unnest_wider(features) |>
  unnest_wider(properties) |>
  unnest_wider(geometry, names_sep = "_") |>
  select(incident, gis_acres, fire_year, agency, state, geometry_coordinates) |>
  mutate(
    gis_acres = as.numeric(gis_acres),
    fire_year = as.integer(fire_year)
  )
```

```{r}
august_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(stringr::str_detect(incident, "August"))
nrow(august_fires)

dplyr::slice_max(fires, gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
```

```{r}
big_fires <- fires |>
  dplyr::filter(gis_acres >= 100000) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    representative_point = purrr::map(geometry_coordinates, \(coordinates) {
      coordinates <- matrix(unlist(coordinates), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
      c(lon = mean(coordinates[, 1]), lat = mean(coordinates[, 2]))
    })
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest_wider(representative_point)
```

```{r}
largest_fires <- big_fires |>
  dplyr::slice_max(gis_acres, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE)
coordinates <- purrr::map(
  largest_fires$geometry_coordinates,
  \(x) matrix(unlist(x), ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE)
)
all_coordinates <- do.call(rbind, coordinates)

fire_map <- leaflet::leaflet() |>
  leaflet::addTiles()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(largest_fires))) {
  popup <- paste0(
    "<b>", largest_fires$incident[i], "</b><br>Year: ",
    largest_fires$fire_year[i], "<br>Acres: ",
    format(round(largest_fires$gis_acres[i]), big.mark = ",")
  )
  fire_map <- leaflet::addPolygons(
    fire_map,
    lng = coordinates[[i]][, 1],
    lat = coordinates[[i]][, 2],
    popup = popup,
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.5
  )
}
fire_map |>
  leaflet::fitBounds(
    min(all_coordinates[, 1]),
    min(all_coordinates[, 2]),
    max(all_coordinates[, 1]),
    max(all_coordinates[, 2]),
    options = list(padding = c(20, 20))
  )
```
